candidates.prompt: Exact DJI Mini 4 Pro aircraft, factory pale light-grey compact plastic body, photographed in a true left-side profile with the nose pointing left. The real small sub-249-gram folding DJI Mini 4 Pro, with all four arms folded closely against its body and black propellers folded flat along the sides, small orange propeller-tip accents. Preserve the distinctive compact rounded shell and the separate round black fisheye obstacle-sensing lenses at the front upper corners; show only the near-side sensor naturally visible from this side view. One small camera on its short stabilising gimbal beneath the nose. Compact low aircraft resting directly on the studio floor. No tall landing legs, no extended arms, no large Mavic-style rectangular chassis, no extra camera lenses, no remote controller or loose accessories. Make the exact folded aircraft itself fill 85 percent of the image width, centred and entirely visible with a small consistent margin. Eye-level side-view product photograph, crisp physically accurate hardware, original pale-grey material colour preserved. Matte dark studio room and dark floor, a cool white spotlight directly overhead, subtle contact shadow. No people, captions, promotional lettering, watermark or invented accessories.
